title: Light Finds Its Shape
concept: Darkness yielding to form: every scene is light discovering something a little more defined, ending on the name.

music.query: dark cinematic orchestral swell, no vocals, 70 bpm
music.notes: drone opens, swell lands on the title at 6.8s

scenes.name: Emergence
scenes.composition: Centered kicker and one serif line over a deep particle field; dark orb barely visible behind
text: Every story begins in the dark.
scenes.background: Three.js dust field in deep fog, unlit metallic orb
scenes.animation: Kicker fades down from blur; words surface from blur one by one; whole stack dissolves forward
scenes.transition: Stack blurs out forward as the key light starts to rise
scenes.narration: Every story begins in the dark.

scenes.name: Light arrives
scenes.composition: Left-aligned rule and line; the orb lights up warm on the right third
scenes.background: Key and rim lights rise on the orb; haze glow blooms
scenes.animation: Gold rule draws left to right, line revealed by a moving clip mask, drifts out right
scenes.transition: Line slides out as the camera cranes up toward the title

scenes.name: Title
scenes.composition: Huge serif VYBE centered inside the glowing halo ring, tagline beneath
scenes.background: Orb fully lit, halo ring ignites around the title
scenes.animation: Letters land from depth with blur, flare wipes across, slow push holds
scenes.camera: Crane up with a gentle push
scenes.transition: Hold on the lockup to the end
scenes.music: Swell peaks on the title, rings out
